source_side.SOURCE_POINT_STATE: x in C_perp(O,r), the accepted orthogonal/continuous compatibility circle with fixed source center O and source radius r
source_side.SOURCE_COMPATIBILITY_CHART: iota(a,b)=(a+b/2,(sqrt(3)/2)b); source squared radius in this chart is a^2+ab+b^2
source_side.SOURCE_CYCLIC_ORDER: positive orientation of rays from O in the orthogonal compatibility plane
source_side.SOURCE_ARC_MEASURE: ordinary source-side Euclidean arc measure on C_perp(O,r)
source_side.SOURCE_CIRCUMFERENCE_FUNCTIONAL: total source arc measure around C_perp(O,r)
source_side.typing_guard: all metric/equidistance language in this object is SOURCE_ONLY

target_side.TARGET_STATE: the AL canonical Enterprise fixed-length segment/turn state
target_side.TARGET_ENDPOINT_ORBIT: the unique final-ADM_E orbit established by AL, equal to the accepted AK N orbit
target_side.TARGET_TURN: one application of tau_E, equivalently one oriented canonical boundary edge
target_side.TARGET_RADIUS_CLASS: the Enterprise anchor length-class label r

comparison_policy.same_r_means: source radius class r is compared with the already fixed target anchor class r; it does not assert metric identity
comparison_policy.preferred_bridge_carrier: target elementary turns/edges rather than vertices, because one target circumference unit is one legal turn
comparison_policy.boundary_ties: retain a closed-fiber relation rather than manufacture a metric tie-breaking function
